native_timing_boundary: Preflight API call through normal CSV report completion, including parse/context/projection/inventory/header work. Startup/import/setup excluded and reported separately. Outer launch/exit includes artefact writing/shutdown.
instrumentation: No profiler or tracing wrappers in native timing. cProfile runs are separate, default elapsed clock; counts are diagnostic and profiled durations are not native costs.
partial_attempts: Two preliminary parity-only attempts stopped before native timing to tighten fallback ordering and custom attribute-mapping guards. Raw receipts retained privately. Accepted experimental receipts all use dbdc4d8. No cross-source pooling.
limitations: Uncontrolled background load, CPU affinity/frequency and warm OS caches; no cold-storage or statistical significance claim.
Large drift and overlapping timings. Direction reverses between native campaigns; performance retention criterion not met.
No SMB measurement, solver, model edit, venv, worktree, new PR, parent change, release or PR merge.
Model/control/database source and command-list guards do not hash every GIS/raster/time-series payload.
